paymentMethodSettings.description: A list of CommercePaymentMethodSettingPublic corresponding to individual payment methods.

activeCurrencies.description: A list of currencies that are active on this account and are suitable for the bundled commercePaymentMethod. Valid values are tied to the Multicurrency options available on the account.

commercePaymentMethod.description: The type of payment method. Valid values include 'CASH', 'CHECK', 'WIRE_TRANSFER', 'CARD', 'ACH', 'SEPA', 'BACS', 'PADS', 'KLARNA', 'AFFIRM', and 'OTHER'.

isDefaultOn.description: A boolean indicating whether this payment method is set as the default option.

supportedCurrencies.description: A full list of currencies that are supported by the bundled commercePaymentMethod.

schema.description: Represents an error response returned by the API when an operation fails. This component is used in various endpoints to provide detailed information about the error encountered.

example.message: Invalid input (details will vary based on the error)

correlationId.description: A unique identifier for the request. Include this value with any error reports or support tickets

items.description: Represents detailed information about an error that occurred in the API. This component is used to provide additional context and specifics about errors, typically as part of an error response.

code.description: The status code associated with the error detail

in.description: The name of the field or parameter in which the error was found.

message.description: A human readable message describing the error along with remediation steps where appropriate

subCategory.description: A specific category that contains more specific detail about the error

links.description: A map of link names to associated URIs containing documentation about the error or recommended remediation steps
